description: This file defines the Github provider class for OAuth2 authentication, handling authorization URLs, access token retrieval, user resource fetching, response checking, and resource owner creation within the League OAuth2 client library.

classes.name: Github
classes.description: A provider class for GitHub OAuth2 authentication, extending AbstractProvider to handle OAuth flow specific to GitHub.

methods.name: getBaseAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to redirect users for GitHub OAuth authorization.

methods.name: getBaseAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to retrieve an access token from GitHub.

methods.name: getResourceOwnerDetailsUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to fetch user details from GitHub API.

methods.name: getDefaultScopes
methods.description: Returns the default OAuth scopes used by this provider.

methods.name: checkResponse
methods.description: Checks the HTTP response from GitHub API for errors and throws exceptions if needed.

methods.name: createResourceOwner
methods.description: Creates and returns a user resource object based on the API response.
